### Temptation's Source
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/temptations-source
Passage: James 1:13-15
Points:
- Authentic faith recognizes that while God allows trials to test believers, He never tempts anyone to sin.
- Temptation does not originate with God, but is birthed from our own fallen desires.
- Difficult circumstances can tempt believers to rationalize moral failures and blame God.
- Christians must take personal responsibility for their sinful inclinations and turn to repentance.

### Growing in Gratitude for Gifts from Above
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/gratitude-for-gifts-from-above-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: James 1:17
Points:
- Every blessing in life flows intentionally from a generous Creator rather than by chance.
- Believers should cultivate eyes to see ordinary daily mercies alongside dramatic answers to prayer.
- Unlike shifting earthly circumstances, God's nature and goodness remain constant.
- Practicing intentional gratitude shifts focus away from perceived lack toward God's sufficiency.
